Physician, born at Cook’s Corners, Fort Covington, son of DeWitt Hutchins and Grace Southworth.
He trained at New York University’s University and Bellevue Hospital Medical College,
graduating in 1911, and married Jennette Margaret Watson, daughter of Alexander Watson,
He practised in the Saranac country of Clinton County: health officer of the town of Saranac from 1916 and of the
village of Dannemora from 1917, and a member of the Medical Society of the State of New York;
the Clinton County society elected him vice-president in 1919 and again for 1925.
He died of coronary thrombosis on 5 March 1935, aged 49.
Buried at Independence Cemetery, Saranac; a Shrine emblem on the stone.
